strings: r_c0 lightly scolds m_c when {PRONOUN/r_c0/subject} {VERB/r_c0/notice/notices} that in all of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} stimming, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/have/has} become a body biter.
Reluctantly, m_c has to admit {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} might have a problem with body biting.
m_c stares at {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} bleeding paws with the realisation that it's self inflicted.
